notes: Shared UI: Decisions - any agent asks the user with ask_user (question, options, default, recommendation) and carries on with its default; kept in FilesDir/decisions (open.jsonl, answered.jsonl), a note in the Chat and OAgent told when a sub-agent asked; answered by a tap on an option in the overlay or in words to OAgent (answer_decision); the answer goes to the asker as a message; Decisions is the drawer's first row with the open count. The drawer's top rows: Decisions, Agents, Audit (moved out of Advanced), Memory, then the sections. Tests (decisions, chat, ui)
